verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for accounting SaaS, but nothing in the evidence describes acting on many invoices, receipts or bookings at once. The REST API (sevdesk-docs-23) is a developer building block that could be used to script batch work, not a bulk-operations feature itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
